## Who am I?

My name is Raydon Diab. I am a data science major, with a minor in AI engineering at Brigham Young University - Idaho. I graduate July 2028. 
I love problem solving. It is something that I pride myself on. I want to use my abilities and knowledge to create lasting change in the world. I mainly use
Python and RStudio, though I have experience in SQL, Excel, Tableau and PowerBI. I am cuurently not looking for employment, though I am open to internship opportunites.

- Python: data wrangling, data visualization, machine learning

- R: Tidyverse, data wrangling

- SQL: Database management

- PowerBI: Integration with PowerApps and PowerAutomate
